historical_mapping.mapping_rule: Every files[].path maps unchanged to the ZIP member of the same name and to blob/<baseline_commit>/<path>. Raw historical Markdown/JSON and hashes are not rewritten.

limits: Static/dynamic source review does not prove absence of external consumers. Users needing old snapshot verification must use fixed baseline checkout or separately restored tree.
DOCX does not represent new physics validation; media and Markdown remain tracked.

The legacy demo02 recursive preservation helper remains unchanged. A fresh snapshot covers files present; checking an old snapshot that expected this DOCX requires a baseline checkout or separately restored tree.
The ZIP contains only the listed DOCX, not the rest of the milestone, external media, H5 data, models, environment, or code. All unselected tracked files stay in place.

restoration.destination_rule: A new directory outside any existing Git worktree; no overwrite or repository mutation.
restoration.layout: Original repository-relative paths below the new destination root.
restoration.hash_requirement: Archive SHA256 and size plus every member path, byte size and SHA256 must pass before restoration creates output.
